title: Low Poly Golden Retriever — Beto
author: Agustin Arroyo / Flowalistik
licenseEvidence: Root agent verified author original upload and CC BY-SA 4.0 linked license, remix and commercial permissions in official Printables browser. Alternative Pinshape listing is BY-ND; this distribution specifically uses the author Printables BY-SA offer.

orientation.conversion: STL rotated X -90 degrees then Y 180 degrees, recentered to ground and multiplied by 0.01

displaySizeSuggestion.basis: Editorial sitting animal total height, including head, not shoulder height or photo measurement.

shoulderReference.measurement: Standing withers height; not this sitting mesh total height

changes: All 444 STL triangles retained; axes and units changed; plain PBR coat material added. Adapter adds authored palette and face atlas, plus smooth coordinate-only deformation. No rig or generated motion.
limitations: Original two position-welded components and open boundaries retained; not a single watertight source.
Face detail limited to authored paint on existing facets.
